steps.content:
You should **not buy from either one for the full warranty** - and especially not from Seller A.

Here's why:

**Seller A - Ottervale Audio**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/p7t946/a

**Seller B - Brackmoor Sound**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/p7t946/b

On price and terms they are identical:
* $129.00
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* Both list "1-year limited warranty" and the same specs

The only difference is authorization:

1. Seller A claims:
> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

2. Seller B makes no such claim.

3. Quellwyn's own list says:
> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/p7t946/dealers

Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.

That means:

* Seller A is making a provably false statement that it is an authorized dealer entitled to give you the full manufacturer warranty.
* Seller B is also not authorized, so its "1-year limited warranty" cannot be the Quellwyn full manufacturer warranty described by Quellwyn.

If you have to choose between *only* these two, B is less dishonest than A because it doesn't falsely claim authorized status. But in reality you shouldn't choose either if you want the real manufacturer warranty.

Buy the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 from one of the actual authorized dealers instead: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics.
